title: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body: Model Serving now supports [Kimi K3](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#kimi-k3) as a Databricks-hosted model. This 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture of experts (MoE) model has native vision capabilities, supports a 1 million token context window, and is designed for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).
